Definition: from G575 and G3708; to consider attentively:--look.
BiblicalUsage: To look toward, to consider — looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of our faith, and Paul waiting to see how it will go with him in prison. The word is a fixed gaze, whether on the Saviour or on the outcome God will give.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe looking unto Jesus is the whole of the Christian life in one verb: I look away from everything else, and I keep looking at him.
